# Ray Ro

> Ray Ro is a Dubai-based DJ, producer and music curator (Afro House, Melodic House, Indie Dance, Organic House) working with luxury hotels, beach clubs, private and corporate events across the UAE, the GCC and internationally. Bookings: bookings@rayrosound.com · WhatsApp +971 58 582 0397 · managed by Sviatlana Leonava.

## Key facts
- Based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Travels across the GCC and worldwide.
- Music curator & DJ at Caña Beach, The Ritz-Carlton JBR (2022–present); music curator at Rüya, The St. Regis Dubai The Palm; resident DJ at LY-LA, Alaya DIFC (2024–present); former resident DJ at SAL, Burj Al Arab (2022–2023); S Bar & Privilege, SLS Dubai.
- F1 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2025, Yas Marina Circuit: main stage and official podium stage, opening for Adam Port.
- Also: UFC Fan Zone Stage Abu Dhabi, Google × Abu Dhabi Gaming (Move 2025), Marriott global event at St. Regis The Palm, Global Citizen Forum Ras Al Khaimah.
- Verified Spotify artist; releases include "Don't Leave Me" (with Mudra), "Dark Side of the Moon" (with ZĒL), "Sweet Dreams", "Together", "Tokyo"; tracks supported by BLOND:ISH and Francis Mercier.
- Formats: sunset sessions, beach club and rooftop residencies, hotel music direction, weddings, brand launches, corporate and gala events, festival stages, villa and yacht parties.
- Technical setup: USB / Rekordbox, 2× Pioneer CDJ-3000, Pioneer DJM-V10/A9/900NXS2 mixer (full rider in the EPK, page 19).
